concerns.text: Task T016b (Seed‑Specific SVD Orchestrator) is listed before Task T053 (Update SVD orchestration to consume the mask derived in T052). Since T053 modifies the orchestrator to use the mask produced by T052, T016b must come *after* T053 (and after T052/T052a). The current ordering violates the producer‑before‑consumer dependency, risking a broken orchestrator if executed in the listed sequence.
